svg.aria-label: How many input values land on each pixel of an 8 by 8 transposed-convolution output from a 4 by 4 input. With kernel 3 and stride 2 the counts alternate 1, 2, 4 in a checkerboard; with kernel 4 and stride 2 every interior pixel receives 4
